# ActionCard

Rich content inside an assistant turn — a `POIResultList`, a `POIResultCard`, a hand-off.

- **Import:** `import { ActionCard } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Core
- **Platforms:** React; not linked to Figma yet.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/product-sdk-actioncard--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import { ActionCard, ThemeProvider } from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function ActionCardExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <ActionCard title="2 results">A POIResultList sits here.</ActionCard>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## ActionCard

Rich content inside an assistant turn: a POIResultList, a POIResultCard, a
hand-off. It holds them and nothing more — Story 5 AC3 requires that results
here open the same details and start the same wayfinding as Agentic Search,
which only stays true if this does not reimplement a result.

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `ActionCardProps`, which extends `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">`.

- `title`: `React.ReactNode`, optional.

  An optional heading above the content, e.g. "2 results".

- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
